content.text:
I changed `_captureSnapshot` in `packages/playwright-core/src/server/trace/recorder/tracing.ts` so the DOM snapshot capture is tied to the progress budget. The old code awaited `captureSnapshot` directly. When the page's main thread was busy, that wait never finished, so the 3-second budget couldn't cut it off and the call never got a response.

The capture is now wrapped in `progress.race(...)` inside a `try/catch`, the same way `_captureCoverage` already does it. If the budget runs out, the snapshot is skipped and the call carries on. Failed snapshots were already ignored, so that part behaves as before.

I couldn't build or run anything, so this is untested, including your repro.

I didn't touch the lint check that misses this spot because of the optional chaining. I removed the `?.` on this call, since the `started()` check just above already guarantees `_snapshotter` is set.
